title: Paul McCartney live: Target Center, Minneapolis | 2016
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Target Center in Minneapolis, Minnesota, USA, on 4 May 2016.

It was the eighth show of the One On One Tour, which lasted for 77 dates between April 2016 and December 2017, and the first of two consecutive nights in Minneapolis.

During the encore McCartney performed a cover of Prince’s ‘Let’s Go Crazy’.

Here’s to the man. Loved that guy. Thank you Prince, for writing so many beautiful songs, so much music. And hes your guy.

Prince, Minneapolis; Minneapolis, Prince. It goes together.

Paul McCartney

Hometown tribute to Prince #OneOnOne pic.twitter.com/7StoXm3Wog

— Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) May 5, 2016

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).
